moments.author: Naomi Osaka
moments.quote: Outfit inspired by Iverson—sweats, headband, cornrows—as a tribute
moments.why: Her US Open look honoring NBA icon Allen Iverson ignited massive social buzz and even got his public response.
moments.url: Allen Iverson called her tribute “an honor” on social media, as widely reported by Yahoo Sports and AP News

moments.author: Allen Iverson
moments.quote: Wow, what a honor!! BIG FAN can’t wait to meet you.
moments.why: His affectionate public reaction to Osaka's tribute fueled the story’s spread even more.
moments.url: Allen Iverson responded on social media to Osaka’s tribute, per Yahoo Sports reporting

moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: Not in a rush to sign extension, talks will happen at the right time
moments.why: Fans care deeply about his future—and delaying extension talks is dominating pre-season chatter.
moments.url: Reported via Bay Area Breakdown quoting Curry on contract extension timing
